headline: System is miserable because the iron-condor process lost money at scale (~17% WR, PF<1, negative expectancy), scaled width/size before edge, churned sub-24h, and has not yet produced a put-credit validation sample.

loss_clusters.label: 10-wide or wider wings
loss_clusters.recommendation: Never reintroduce 10-wide SPY wings in validation; max risk per structure is too large for the observed win rate.

loss_clusters.label: Iron condor / IC Simple family
loss_clusters.recommendation: IC family is killed as North Star candidate; do not reopen entries.

loss_clusters.label: More than one contract
loss_clusters.recommendation: 1-lot only until positive expectancy, PF>1, and positive total P/L clear on the successor cohort.

loss_clusters.label: Held 7 days or longer
loss_clusters.recommendation: Force-exit by 7 DTE; slow losers dominate dollar damage even when rare.

loss_clusters.label: Closed in under 24 hours
loss_clusters.recommendation: Require min 24h hold except hard stop; theta strategies die under sub-day churn.

loss_clusters.label: Closed in under 1 hour
loss_clusters.recommendation: Do not open setups whose expected management requires intraday repair; enforce a minimum hold unless a hard max-loss fires.

loss_clusters.label: 5-wide or narrower wings
loss_clusters.recommendation: Keep successor structures at $5 wings until n>=30 proves edge.

root_causes.title: Primary strategy family has negative expectancy at large sample
root_causes.explanation: Iron condors were the only closed family. Lifetime expectancy and profit factor fail kill criteria — this is not a small-sample fluke.

root_causes.title: 10-wide wings dominate dollar losses

evidence.label: 10-wide or wider wings
evidence.recommendation: Never reintroduce 10-wide SPY wings in validation; max risk per structure is too large for the observed win rate.

root_causes.explanation: Most closed structures used ~$10 wings. Max loss per lot is roughly 10x credit room vs $5 wings, and the observed win rate cannot pay for that risk.

root_causes.title: Scaled lot size before proving edge

evidence.label: More than one contract
evidence.recommendation: 1-lot only until positive expectancy, PF>1, and positive total P/L clear on the successor cohort.

root_causes.explanation: Multi-lot trades show worse expectancy than 1-lot. Size amplified a negative process.

root_causes.title: Mass sub-24h exits destroyed theta edge

evidence.label: Closed in under 24 hours
evidence.recommendation: Require min 24h hold except hard stop; theta strategies die under sub-day churn.

root_causes.explanation: A large share of trades closed in under a day. Credit-spread edge needs time; churn converts the book into fee/slippage + stop hunting.

root_causes.title: Long-hold losers dominate residual P/L damage

evidence.label: Held 7 days or longer
evidence.recommendation: Force-exit by 7 DTE; slow losers dominate dollar damage even when rare.

root_causes.explanation: Fewer long holds still account for large absolute losses — missing 7-DTE force exit or stop discipline on tested structures.

root_causes.title: Successor put-credit cohort has zero closed trades
root_causes.explanation: IC was killed and put-credit is active on paper, but the ledger has no put-credit closed sample. Automation without a clean successor sample is not an edge.

root_causes.title: ML priors assumed ~86% IC win rate; realized ~17%

evidence.note: Thompson model eventually updated, but for months decisions optimized against fantasy priors.

root_causes.explanation: Research priors (Tastytrade 15Δ IC) were used as if they were this system's edge. Agentic RAG/ML then optimized around a false baseline until empirical feedback caught up.

root_causes.title: System complexity outran process control

symptoms: global TRADING_HALTED driven by killed family metrics

root_causes.explanation: Self-healing workflows, GRPO, and multi-agent orchestration cannot create expectancy. They can only amplify whatever entry/exit rules exist — and those rules lost money.

operator_actions: Do not reopen IC / ic_simple entries.
Keep paper-only put-credit validation: 1-lot, $5 wide, min 24h hold, max 2 concurrent.
Clear unclean open inventory before new risk.
Gate on put-credit cohort metrics only (n>=30, expectancy>0, PF>1) — not IC lifetime.
Treat GRPO/Thompson as advisory until successor sample exists; never as proof of edge.
not_the_reason: Lack of workflows or heartbeats (ops automation is present).
Lack of lessons files (RAG corpus is large but was not binding process control).
Need for more model complexity before process control.
